description:
France and Brazil squared off in this international friendly, where Kylian Mbappe opened the scoring in the first half for Didier Deschamps’ side. Dayot Upamecano was sent off early in the second half before  Hugo Ekitike doubled the lead for Les Bleus. Bremer brought Carlo Ancelotti’s side within a goal, however France defeated Brazil, 2-1.
